runs.scenario: Suppose the Coalition qualifies in 44 other districts, and the VEC has withdrawn its indicative two-candidate count in the decisive district because it used the wrong pairing, but the old figures remain visible and show a Liberal ahead. If the ABC predicts a non-Coalition winner, one reader could treat the visible figures as a VEC count and resolve YES, while another could treat the withdrawn count as no current VEC count, use the ABC fallback, and resolve NO.

Three-cornered contests count only once per district, and failed or deferred elections do not count.
